decisions.reason: Glass core substrates for advanced packaging remain a highly uncertain but potentially large market, and keeping the ACT copper-coated offering visible costs Plan Optik little while it builds on its core glass wafer competence, so the option is worth holding open.

VLIS was just launched in 2024 with a dedicated page, complements Product A in the through-glass-via value chain, and has had too little time for its uncertainty to resolve, so abandoning it now would forfeit a cheap growth option.
